items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: listen to other people that came before, like Lester Young or somebody like that, and sing their part.

ctx.x: A cool guy and a cool day. I would like to ask you first about your guitar institute that you’re working on, your guitar business, your school.

Well it isn’t a big school, but what I do, I mean if I had to earn a living I couldn’t do it. But being the way I am, like at this part of my life, I like to see people and how they want to do things, these fellas take — some of them throw away everything. They think they’re going to be big stars or something. And they make their own record dates and they put everything they’ve got into this. So I try to tell them, you know, go ahead. It’s your turn to roll the dice. And then they say how did you — I says don’t…
So when you said that they’re just moving their fingers up a few positions and then playing that they don’t know the notes that they’re playing? Is that what you’re saying?
